entities.summary: The Ertuğrul Tekke Mosque is an Ottoman imperial mosque located in Yıldız neighbourhood, Serencebey rise of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey. A late Ottoman period mosque, it is constructed as a külliye consisting of an Ottoman takya, guest house, türbe, fountain, and library in addition to the mosque.
